services.name: 🎄 Lead Boat Experience – Christmas Boat Parade
services.desc: Christmas Boat Parade Lead Boat Experience – December 13 Join us aboard the Marina Rose for the best seat in the parade! As the lead boat in Hernando Beach’s beloved Christmas Boat Parade, you’ll set the course for an unforgettable night of holiday cheer. Enjoy a festive dinner cruise complete with a delicious meal, drinks, and the magic of twinkling lights reflected on the water. Cruise through the waterways of Hernando Beach aboard our fully enclosed, paddle-wheel–style vessel—a signature experience that blends comfort, beauty, and tradition. This exclusive event includes: Reserved seating Lead Boat Experience - Christmas Boat Parade

services.name: Thanksgiving Dinner Cruise
services.desc: Join Us for a Thanksgiving Dinner Cruise on the Marina Rose! 🦃🌊 This Thanksgiving, leave the cooking to us and celebrate aboard the Marina Rose, Hernando Beach’s classic paddle-wheel boat. Enjoy a catered feast of traditional holiday favorites, breathtaking views, and the warmth of family and friends – all while gliding through serene coastal waters. 🍽️ Thanksgiving Menu: Roasted Turkey with savory dressing and rich gravy Cranberry Relish for a sweet and tangy touch Sweet Potato Casserole topped with crunchy pecans Fresh Green Beans steamed to perfection Creamy Mashed Potatoes Fluffy Enjoy a delicious catered feast while cruising along the serene waters of Hernando Beach.

services.name: 🌅 Last Sunset of the Year 🥂 New Year's Eve Celebration 🍾
services.desc: Close out the year in unforgettable fashion aboard the Marina Rose. Join us for our Last Sunset of the Year Cruise on New Year’s Eve, where golden Gulf waters, a glowing horizon, and an intimate onboard atmosphere set the stage for a truly special evening. As the sun dips below the water, enjoy a chef-prepared prime rib dinner, thoughtfully served while you relax in our climate-controlled cabin or step outside to take in the final sunset of the year. When the moment is just right, we’ll raise a champagne 🥂 toast together, celebrating the year behind us and welcoming the promise of the year Prime Rib Dinner & Champagne Toast
